title: Tech Note: Object Columns in Listboxes
author: Timothy Tse, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: The v15-introduced List Box object-column feature described here (mixed-type columns driven by a 4D object array, requiring a 4D View Pro license) remains part of current 4D, so this note's technical content is still directly applicable; it's a narrow, still-valid feature note rather than one made obsolete by later changes.
related_updates: 4D View Pro itself has continued to expand (spreadsheet-grade features, pivot tables, charts) well beyond this note's scope
Object columns in list boxes remain supported and are commonly combined with ORDA entity selections in modern 4D apps
